title: Escalated Late Charges on Microsoft 365 Annual Invoices for Clients Late on ClearPath
content:
**Escalation clause.** The late charge on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) annual cycle invoice is escalated for a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services account also ran late. The multiplier depends on the late fees the ClearPath billing ledger shows posted less than twelve whole months before the assessment date:

- two or more such late fees: the late charge is multiplied by **1.5**;
- exactly one: the late charge is multiplied by **1.25**;
- none: no escalation applies.

**Which late fees count.** The count is taken from the late fee entries on the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services billing ledger. A ClearPath late fee posted on the same day of the month twelve months before the assessment date is not less than twelve whole months before, so it does not count.

| ClearPath late fees, less than twelve whole months before assessment | Multiplier on the late charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | no escalation |
| 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 | 1.5 |
| 3 or more | 1.5 |

## Hypothetical illustration (assessment on 1 June)

The client's ClearPath billing ledger shows late fees posted on 1 June and 1 November of the previous year, and on 1 February of this year.

- The 1 June fee is exactly twelve months earlier, so it does not count.
- The other two count, so the multiplier is 1.5.
- A late charge of 80.00 USD before the multiplier becomes 120.00.

With only the 1 February fee on the ledger, the multiplier would be 1.25, and the 80.00 would become 100.00.
